boxes.name: a box that cuts a loop gives it, but not a stage whose line crosses the box between two vertices
a vertex on the west edge is in the box
the start of a long route gives its first stage, not the long route
a box of another bike gives only its kind
the same box for hiking gives the stage with a vertex in it
a box across a cell edge gives a route of both cells once
a cell without a file adds nothing
